title: The Lambda role allows `bedrock:*` on every resource
recommendation: Replace the statement with bedrock:InvokeModel and bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream on the three application inference profiles and their foundation models, bedrock:ApplyGuardrail on the guardrail, bedrock:Retrieve on the knowledge base, and the batch inference actions for the enrich job only.

title: Application logs keep customer prompts with personal data, unencrypted and forever
observed: 8 sampled log events hold 1 loyalty card number and 2 phone numbers; 3 of 3 log groups have no KMS key and 2 never expire
recommendation: Stop logging raw prompts (log token counts and request IDs), redact PII in the handler before any log call, anonymize PII in the guardrail, and encrypt the log groups with a customer managed KMS key and a retention period.

title: The compare route calls the model with no guardrail
recommendation: Attach one versioned guardrail to every route: prompt-attack and content filters, the denied competitor-pricing topic, and PII anonymization on input and output. Call it through guardrailConfig on each Converse request.

title: The ask route uses Claude Sonnet where Claude Haiku meets the quality bar
observed: ask uses claude-sonnet; claude-haiku passes 93.6% overall, 90% in its weakest category
recommendation: Move the ask route to Claude Haiku through its application inference profile once the evaluation stage is in the pipeline. Keep Claude Sonnet on compare, where Haiku falls below the bar.

title: Every interactive request pays full price for the 2,400-token system prompt
observed: PROMPT_CACHING is off on ask, compare (system prompt tokens: ask 2,400, compare 2,400)
recommendation: Put a cache point after the system prompt in each Converse request so repeated requests read the prefix from the cache.

title: The knowledge base keeps 4 OpenSearch Serverless OCUs running for 2 GB of vectors
observed: 4 OCUs on average for 2 GB of vector data
recommendation: Move the knowledge base to Amazon S3 Vectors, re-ingest, compare retrieval on the golden set, then delete the collection.

title: The API has no throttling and no per-channel quota
observed: stage throttling unset (rate limit -1); 0 usage plans
recommendation: Set stage-level throttling and one usage plan per channel (web, mobile app, store kiosk) with rate, burst and daily quota, and alarm when the 4XX rate climbs.

title: No evaluation runs before a prompt or model change reaches production
observed: pipeline stages: lint, unit-test, package, deploy-staging, deploy-production
recommendation: Run the golden set in the pipeline between deploy-staging and deploy-production, and block the release when the pass rate falls under 90% overall or 85% in any category.

title: Model invocation logging is off
recommendation: Enable Bedrock model invocation logging to a KMS-encrypted CloudWatch Logs group with one-year retention, with the guardrail masking PII before logging.

title: The nightly enrich job uses on-demand inference
observed: offline routes on on-demand inference: enrich
recommendation: Submit the nightly descriptions as one Bedrock batch inference job from S3 and read the results back in the morning run.

title: The bill cannot show model usage by route or cost center
recommendation: Create one application inference profile per route, tagged with app, route and cost center, and invoke the model through its profile ARN.
